title: Story Writer and Narrative Designer
description:
**Role Overview**

PlotPix is building an AI native microdrama platform for mobile first, vertical storytelling. We create emotionally addictive, binge worthy fiction designed for short episode formats and fast audience payoff.

We are looking for a creative **Story Writer** who can create stories people feel compelled to continue. This is not a pure script formatting role. We already use AI heavily for speed and execution. What we need most is a strong creative mind with sharp instinct for storytelling, emotional progression, character build up, audience pull, narrative rhythm, and what makes a viewer care.

You should be someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into a compelling story engine. Someone who naturally thinks in terms of tension, reversals, chemistry, obsession, secrets, payoffs, emotional spikes, and binge flow.

This role is for people who are excited by new **storytelling formats, can adapt to new audiences quickly, and can use AI as a multiplier rather than as a crutch.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Create original microdrama story concepts with strong audience appeal
* Build lead characters viewers get emotionally invested in, root for, obsess over, hate, or can’t ignore
* Design high retention story arcs with clear emotional movement across episodes
* Shape narration flow, emotional flow, reveals, reversals, cliffhangers, and payoff moments
* Develop stories that feel highly bingeable in a short form vertical format
* Explore multiple creative directions for the same premise and identify the strongest one
* Adapt stories across genres, tones, and audience segments based on brief, platform need, or viewer response
* Work with AI tools to accelerate ideation, expansion, variation, and iteration
* Push past generic ideas and predictable beats to find fresher, sharper story turns
* Collaborate closely with directors, editors, and creative leads to refine stories from concept to final narrative
* Rewrite with intent, not just polish. Improve emotional impact, clarity, pace, and viewer pull
* Continuously learn what works for new formats, new markets, and changing audience tastes

**What We’re Really Looking For**

* Strong instinct for storytelling over scripting
* Strong sense of emotion over exposition
* Strong sense of viewer psychology over technical correctness
* Ability to create characters, conflict, tension, attraction, betrayal, longing, power shifts, and payoff
* Ability to judge whether a story feels flat, forced, repetitive, too safe, too slow, or not emotionally sticky
* High creative aptitude and fast pattern recognition
* Comfort with ambiguity, experimentation, and non traditional workflows
* Curiosity about what different audiences respond to and why
* Ability to use AI effectively while still bringing original taste and judgment

**Ideal Candidate** You may come from fiction writing, screenwriting, web series, audio drama, serialised content, fan fiction communities, creator writing rooms, ad films, narrative design, or any form of storytelling where audience pull matters.

**What matters most is that you can:**

* Think of strong stories fast
* Build characters people care about
* Sustain emotional momentum
* Adapt to feedback without making the story bland
* Create for modern mobile audiences without sounding synthetic or derivative

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in short form fiction, web series, episodic storytelling, romance, thriller, drama, or youth content
* Understanding of Gen Z and young adult entertainment patterns
* Familiarity with cliffhanger design, binge loops, and retention driven storytelling
* Experience using AI tools for brainstorming, iteration, or story development
* Comfort working in a fast paced creative environment with frequent iteration

**Experience** *We are open on background. Years matter less than story instinct. You could be a fit if you have: 1 to 2 years in fiction, screenplay, episodic, digital, or narrative writing or A strong portfolio that shows exceptional storytelling ability, even without conventional experience*

**What Success Looks Like In this role, success means:**

* You consistently generate strong story ideas, not just clean pages
* Your characters feel emotionally alive
* Your episode flows create pull and continuation
* Your stories adapt well to new formats and audience needs
* You improve the quality of the story, not just the wording of the script

**What We Offer**

* Working with a highly skilled, motivated and passionate group of people.
* Exposure to the full product development process from ideation to launch.
* Our culture of experimentation and creativity allows everyone to explore new ideas and approaches and think outside the box.
* Building a product for the global audience.
* A full pantry of munchies.

title: Risk Management  - Business Analyst  - Stress Testing-  Associate
description:
**Nomura Overview:** 




  





 Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East \& West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.
 



  





 Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world\-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations.
 



  





 At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies \& programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well\-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.
 



  





**Division Overview:** 




  





 The Risk Management Division encompasses the firm's comprehensive risk framework responsible for determining and managing the overall risk appetite for the firm. The division is responsible for effectively managing the firm's risk\-return profile which ensures the efficient deployment of the firm's capital. It is one of the firm's core competencies and is independent of the trading areas and operational areas.
 



  





**Business Unit Overview:** 



* Requirements gathering, testing and documentation for regulatory compliance and transformational risk management initiatives.
* Analyse complex risk data flows, calculation engines, and reporting processes to identify gaps and architect robust solutions aligned with enterprise risk appetite.
* Execute projects in adherence with the Nomura governance standards delivering well defined business outcomes.
* cross\-functional collaboration between Risk, Technology, Operations, and Compliance teams while gathering business requirement \& functional requirement.
* Translating business requirements into technical specifications for risk platforms, coordinate system integrations with stakeholders.
* Maintaining cutting\-edge regulatory knowledge, conduct industry benchmarking, and drive continuous improvement through feedback loops and best practice implementation.



  





**What We Offer:** 




  




* We support employee wellbeing by ensuring a sense of purpose and belonging.
* We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
* Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family’s holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.



  





  





**Position Specifications:** 




  





**Corporate Title:** 
 Associate (AVP level)
 



**Experience:** 
 8\-12 years
 



**Qualification:** 
 MBA, FRM, CFA, CQF etc
 



  





  





  





**Role \& Responsibilities:** 




  




* Business Analyst with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in the Risk domain, particularly in Stress Testing, Trading Wind Down (TWD), Counterparty Credit Risk and Market Risk.
* The person is expected to play a lead role for the Stress Testing and TWD projects within International Change and work with local and regional stakeholders to manage the book of work.
* Understand the Nomura Risk Change programme and maintain a dependable team of skilled BAs to be assigned to various projects within it.
* Independently manage medium to large projects through the lifecycle and use BA tools proficiently (business requirement documents, functional specifications, data matrix, Work Flow Diagrams etc.)
* Run test management processes for medium to large scale projects (Test Strategy/Approach documentation, managing User Acceptance Testing, building test plans and test scenarios, building implementation plans.)
* Assist our stakeholder businesses with their tactical/strategic solution requirements, services and/or program.
* Must be able to work with Technology, Risk Management, Risk Middle Office, and Front Office to identify and maximize opportunities that help in delivery of projects and to improve product, service and program business processes.
* Must have the ability to work with a team and train people on various subjects, structure the project governance model and also work together with regional counterparts to devise induction framework for all the resources entering into the project.
* Prepare project reports (weekly project update, monthly status update, highlighting risks, resource utilization, analyses trends, recommends adjustments that address or capitalize on these changes.)
* The role requires full adherence to the work from office roster for the team.



  





  





  





**Mind Set:** 




  





**Domain** 



* Strong understanding of capital market products and derivatives across asset classes
* Good knowledge of Stress Testing across different Risk scenarios, Counterparty Credit Risk domain with project experience in areas like computation of risk measures/exposures (EAD, PE, PFE, EEPE, LEQ, VaR, ES etc.), management of risk limits, risk reporting etc.
* Skilled in performing data analysis and understanding data models for computation of risk measures
* Good understanding of the Basel norms, particularly the capital requirements for Market, Credit and CVA risks
* Ability to operate in both agile and waterfall style project methodologies and have an understanding of deliverables required for each methodology
* Attention to detail and high quality standards of documentation, processes and control environment
* Experience in the full E2E systems delivery lifecycle (SDLC)
* Detailed knowledge of all Microsoft Office products, i.e. Word, Excel, Power Point, Project and Visio
* Good educational pedigree and domain certifications (MBA, FRM, CFA, CQF etc.)
* Excellent communication, organization, prioritisation and documentation skills
* Deals comfortably with ambiguity – Stays on target to complete goals regardless of obstacles or adverse circumstances
* Ability to identify any inefficiencies in processes and suggest ideas for automation and/or operating model changes.



  




* Proficiency in database, virtualization and BI solutions – SQL, Python, Dremio, PowerBI, Alteryx, Tableau etc.
* Flexibility – adapts effectively to changing plans, domains and priorities; Is open and flexible when faced with changing project constraints
* Excellent and demonstrable understanding of “best practice” approaches to functional testing especially User Acceptance Testing.



  





*We are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout employment including in the recruitment, training and development of employees. We prohibit discrimination in the workplace whether on grounds of gender, marital or domestic partnership status, pregnancy, carer’s responsibilities, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, race, color, national or ethnic origins, religious belief, disability or age.* 




  





  





*\*Applying for this role does not amount to a job offer or create an obligation on Nomura to provide a job offer. The expression "Nomura" refers to Nomura Services India Private Limited together with its affiliates.* 




  





*\*The benefits are subject to change and will be in accordance with Company’s policies as may be applicable from time to time).*

title: Manager HRBP
description:
**Job Description:** 




  





 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a strategic and experienced HR leader responsible for partnering with assigned business units to drive human capital strategies that align with and support organization’s overall business objectives. With at least 15 years of progressive HR experience, the HRBP Manager will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing expert counsel on all HR\-related matters. This role emphasizes efficient and effective management of core HR processes and programs (BAU), ensuring operational excellence while also contributing to strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of HR best practices, strong analytical skills, and a proven ability to translate business needs into actionable HR solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Employee Relations Management:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for complex employee relations issues, conducting thorough investigations, advising managers on disciplinary actions, and ensuring compliance with all enGen Global policies and labor laws.
* Mediate and resolve conflicts, grievances, and disputes in a fair and consistent manner, fostering a positive work environment.
* Provide guidance and support to managers and employees on policy interpretation, performance management, and conflict resolution.
* **Performance Management Oversight:**
* Administer and oversee the full performance management cycle, including goal setting, mid\-year reviews, annual appraisals, and performance improvement plans.
* Coach and train managers on effective performance feedback, coaching techniques, and documentation practices.
* Identify and address performance gaps, working with managers to develop strategies for improvement and recognition.
* **Talent Management \& Development (Operational Aspects):**
* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to ensure efficient and effective recruitment and onboarding processes for assigned business units.
* Partner with Learning \& Development to identify training needs based on business requirements and employee development plans, facilitating access to relevant programs.
* Monitor and support career development discussions within business units, guiding employees and managers on available resources and pathways.
* **Compensation \& Benefits Administration:**
* Collaborate with the Compensation and Benefits teams to ensure competitive and equitable compensation practices within assigned business units.
* Advise managers on compensation decisions, including promotions, salary adjustments, and incentive plans, ensuring adherence to enGen Global's compensation philosophy.
* Assist employees with benefits inquiries and enrollment processes, acting as a liaison with the benefits team as needed.
* **Workforce Planning \& Analytics (BAU Reporting):**
* Collect, analyze, and present HR data and metrics (e.g., turnover, absenteeism, diversity, performance data) to identify trends and inform decision\-making.
* Prepare regular HR reports for business unit leaders, highlighting key HR indicators and areas for improvement.
* Support basic workforce planning activities by providing historical data and insights on staffing levels and needs.
* **Policy \& Compliance Adherence:**
* Ensure consistent application of HR policies, procedures, and programs across assigned business units.
* Stay abreast of changes in employment law and HR regulations, ensuring enGen Global's compliance and advising on necessary adjustments.
* Educate managers and employees on HR policies and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of internal guidelines.
* **Organizational Effectiveness \& Change Management (Operational Support):**
* Support the implementation of organizational changes within business units by providing guidance on communication plans, employee transitions, and change management best practices.
* Facilitate team effectiveness initiatives and provide guidance on team dynamics and collaboration.
* Act as a cultural ambassador, promoting enGen Global's values and fostering an inclusive and engaging work environment.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MA in HR) preferred.
* **Experience:**
* Minimum of 15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 12\+ years in an HR Business Partner role, preferably within a large, complex organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex employee relations cases, performance management cycles, and compensation processes.
* Proven track record of effectively operating within established HR frameworks and delivering consistent, high\-quality HR services.
* Experience in the healthcare or insurance industry is highly desirable.
* **Certifications:** 
 SHRM\-SCP or HRCI SPHR certification highly preferred.



  





**Skills:** 



* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to influence and build strong relationships at all levels.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a data\-driven approach to HR.
* High level of emotional intelligence and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of organizational dynamics.



  





**About enGen Global** 




  





**enGen Global** 
 is at the forefront of healthcare's Global Capability Centers (GCC) in India, dedicated to creating powerful and innovative solutions that have a transformative impact on lives. The company's cutting\-edge solutions empower healthcare partners to manage their operations through comprehensive, proven platforms, enabling them to focus on their core strengths – delivering positive experiences to healthcare consumers and ensuring excellence in service and care. enGen Global’s wide\-ranging solutions encompass IT Health Plan and IT Health Consumer Solutions, Application and Platform Management, Enterprise Solutions and Transformations, Development, Testing, Diversified Business Solutions, and Business Process Services. Operating within India's thriving landscape of emerging GCCs, enGen Global boasts a robust partner ecosystem, incorporating best\-in\-class engineering processes, tools, solution accelerators, talent, research, and co\-innovation capabilities.
 



 We believe our people are our greatest asset. title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
HR Generalist
 



 Hybrid — Pune ONLY
 



  





 Overview
 



 We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented HR Generalist to join our team. This is a hybrid position based in Pune, offering a blend of remote and in\-office work. You will play a central role in our HR operations, owning the full employee lifecycle and driving key functions including performance appraisal processes, bonus management, payroll, HR compliance, employee onboarding and offboarding, leave and attendance management, benefits administration, and process creation and management — while ensuring full alignment with Indian labour law. Advanced Excel skills including VBA and dashboard reporting are essential to this role. Full training on our internal systems is provided.
 



  





 Working Hours
 



 This role operates on late\-shift hours to support our operational requirements. Please review carefully before applying:
 


* **Shift:** 
 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST (Monday to Friday)
* The shift includes a one\-hour lunch break.
 **Comfort with late\-shift working is essential for this role.**
* Occasional availability beyond 10:00 PM IST may be required for Leadership Meetings.



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Appraisal Process
 


* Design and manage end\-to\-end performance appraisal cycles across the organization.
* Coordinate appraisal timelines, communication, and follow\-through with department heads.
* Maintain accurate appraisal documentation and track outcomes for reporting purposes.
* Support calibration sessions and ensure fairness and consistency in the appraisal process.



  





 Bonus Management
 


* Administer and process bonus schemes in line with company policy and performance results.
* Calculate and validate bonus figures, ensuring accuracy before payroll integration.
* Maintain bonus records and generate reports for leadership review.
* Communicate bonus outcomes to employees in a clear and professional manner.



  





 Payroll
 


* Manage or closely support end\-to\-end payroll processing on a monthly basis.
* Ensure compliance with all Indian statutory deductions — PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, and TDS.
* Reconcile payroll data and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with finance on payroll approvals and disbursements.



  





 HR Compliance
 


* Ensure organizational compliance with Indian labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain and audit HR documentation — contracts, policies, and employee records.
* Support internal and external audits with accurate, up\-to\-date documentation.
* Monitor regulatory changes and update HR policies and practices accordingly.



  





 Process Creation \& Management
 


* Design, document, and implement HR SOPs and workflows from scratch where needed.
* Continuously review and improve existing HR processes for efficiency and consistency.
* Maintain and update HRIS/HRMS platforms with accurate employee lifecycle data.
* Build and maintain HR dashboards and automated reports using advanced Excel, including VBA.



  





 Onboarding \& Offboarding
 


* Manage pre\-joining documentation, day\-one logistics, and structured induction programs for all new hires.
* Track joining formalities, collect required documents, and update HRIS/HRMS promptly.
* Handle end\-to\-end exit processes — resignation acceptance, notice period tracking, and clearance coordination.
* Coordinate full \& final settlement calculations and ensure timely processing.
* Issue relieving letters, experience certificates, and all separation documentation accurately and on time.



  





 Leave \& Attendance Management
 


* Administer leave policies and manage attendance tracking across the organization.
* Maintain accurate leave records and ensure timely coordination with payroll for Loss of Pay (LOP) processing.
* Handle employee queries related to leave balances, attendance discrepancies, and policy clarifications.



  





 HR Reporting \& Analytics
 


* Produce regular HR reports covering headcount, attrition, leave utilization, and payroll summaries for leadership review.
* Build and maintain automated HR dashboards using advanced Excel and VBA.
* Analyse HR data to identify trends and provide actionable insights to support business decisions.



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of proven HR Generalist experience with hands\-on exposure to appraisals, payroll, and compliance.
* Demonstrated experience managing end\-to\-end performance appraisal and bonus processes.
* Solid understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, TDS).
* Strong payroll management experience — independent or closely supported.
* Proven ability to create and manage HR processes, policies, and SOPs.
* Experience managing onboarding, offboarding, leave, and attendance processes.
* Ability to produce HR reports and analytics covering key workforce metrics.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including
 **VBA and Dashboard development** 
 .
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong organizational ability with the capacity to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* High level of discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive employee data and information.

title: HR (People Operations) Manager
description:
Transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully\-autonomous food production sites
   

  

 At eternal.ag, we're building the future of sustainable food production. Our mission is to convert the world's existing greenhouses into fully\-autonomous facilities that can produce fresh food year\-round \- addressing the critical need to double food production by 2050 while facing severe labor shortages, water scarcity, and climate challenges.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

 We’re hiring a
 ****HR/People Operations Manager****
 to run the day\-to\-day people operations that keep a fast\-growing, global team healthy and high\-performing. Based in our
 ****Bengaluru office****
 , you’ll support core HR operations across India, Germany, and remote team members, building systems that scale while keeping the employee experience human and consistent.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with our Talent Recruiter, team leads, and finance operations to make sure hiring, onboarding, compliance, and people processes are tight, fair, and easy to run.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Own the employee lifecycle end\-to\-end
   

  

 You’ll run the operational backbone for employees from onboarding through role changes, performance cycles, and offboarding. You’ll make sure every stage is clear, timely, and consistent, so managers can lead well and employees can do their best work.
   

  

 Build scalable HR systems for a fast\-growing team
   

  

 You’ll design and implement the processes that help us scale without chaos: policies, workflows, and self\-serve documentation that people actually use. You’ll continuously simplify removing friction, tightening handoffs, and making “how we do things” easy to follow across locations.
   

  

 Run multi\-country compliance with confidence
   

  

 You’ll coordinate employment law, HR compliance, and documentation across India, Germany, and remote arrangements working with external counsel and local experts where needed. You’ll ensure contracts, statutory requirements, and internal practices stay up to date as regulations and the team evolve.
   

  

 Own payroll, benefits, and HR administration
   

  

 You’ll manage HR operations with precision: payroll coordination, benefits administration, leave policies, reimbursements, and employee records. You’ll be the person who catches issues before they become problems and who builds repeatable workflows so nothing depends on heroics.
   

  

 Partner with Talent on hiring and onboarding
   

  

 You’ll work closely with our Talent Recruitment Specialist to ensure smooth candidate\-to\-employee handoff, onboarding plans, and first\-week readiness (accounts, equipment coordination, documentation, and team intros). You’ll help improve onboarding based on feedback and outcomes, not just checklists.
   

  

 Bring structure to performance and feedback
   

  

 You’ll implement lightweight, consistent performance practices that fit a startup context \- goal setting, check\-ins, calibration support, and clear documentation. You’ll help managers handle feedback well, address issues early, and keep decisions fair and transparent.
   

  

 Who You Are
   

  

 Core requirements
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in human resources, business, or related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in People Operations / HR, ideally in a fast\-growing startup or high\-change environment
* Strong hands\-on experience running People Operations across India (and coordinating with other countries or remote employment models)
* Experience owning employee lifecycle processes: onboarding, performance cycles, role changes, offboarding
* Operational excellence: you’re organized, detail\-oriented, and reliable with confidential information
* Strong communication skills and good judgment: you can handle sensitive topics with clarity and care
* High ownership mindset: you see gaps, propose solutions, and make the system better without waiting for perfect direction


 Bonus points if you have
   

  

* Built HR processes from scratch (workflows, performance cycles)
* HR analytics comfort (dashboards, basic automation, lightweight reporting)
* Experience supporting remote\-first or distributed teams across time zones
* Familiarity with common HR tools (e.g., Rippling, Deel/Remote) and improving workflows across them


 What We Offer
   

  

****Real ownership:****
 You’ll own the people\-ops engine that supports a global team and your work will directly influence how well we scale.
   

  

****Build from scratch****
 (with support): You’ll establish the foundations, systems, and rhythms that the company will run on for years.
   

  

****High\-leverage work****
 : Great people operations unlock faster hiring, smoother onboarding, stronger teams, and better retention.
   

  

****Global team****
 : Work across our Cologne HQ and Bengaluru office with a tight, mission\-driven team and short feedback loops.
   

  

****Mission that matters:****
 Help build the team enabling fully automated greenhouses and more resilient, sustainable food production worldwide.
   

  

 Apply Now
   

  

**Send Us a Short Note With**
* A few lines on what motivates you about building great people operations in fast\-growing companies (and why eternal.ag)
* Your CV and/or LinkedIn profile

 ****candidates****
 of all backgrounds who are passionate about building great people operations and enabling high\-performing teams.

title: HR Coordinator, EOR
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

****What is an Employer of Record (EOR)?****
 An Employer of Record (EOR) is a service provider that allows companies to legally hire and work with employees in foreign countries without establishing their own legal entity in that country. This is made possible through a legal arrangement where the EOR establishes its own legal entity in the country and hires employees on behalf of the client company. This arrangement offers a viable solution for companies that wish to expand their global reach without investing in setting up a legal entity in every country where they operate.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an HR Coordinator, you will serve as the first point of contact for client and employee inquiries, providing guidance and support on straightforward HR matters while ensuring timely and accurate responses. You will manage and triage inquiries through our ticketing system, handling cases within your expertise and escalating more complex matters to Senior HR Advisors.
   

  

 This role is integral to maintaining service efficiency and ensuring adherence to key performance metrics such as response and resolution times. You’ll collaborate with team members across regions, applying a proactive and resourceful approach to deliver exceptional service to our clients and employees.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Ticket Management: Own the ticketing system by responding to inquiries in a timely and professional manner, ensuring alignment with service level agreements (SLAs).
* First\-Line HR Support: Address straightforward HR questions, including leave policies, performance management basics, system navigation, and updating employee information.
* Case Escalation: Provide initial responses to more complex cases (e.g., terminations, claims), gathering necessary details before assigning them to Senior HR Advisors for further action.
* Global Expertise: Research and provide accurate answers for inquiries across multiple countries globally or within the geo\-region, leveraging the internal provided resources and tools.
* Metrics Accountability: Ensure prompt first responses and efficient case resolution to meet team performance targets.
* Cross\-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Senior HR Advisors, fellow HR Coordinators, Legal Associates and Counsels, Operations Associates, Regional Managers, and other internal teams to address client and employee needs comprehensively.
* Documentation \& Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows/documentations and ensure consistency in responses through standardized templates and resources.


**What You Will Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Admin, Communications, or related field required
* 4\+ years of experience in an HR support role within a fast\-paced, client\-facing environment.
* Solid understanding of core HR practices, including leave management, performance management, general employment policies, and HR compliance.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and professionalism.
* A resourceful and proactive mindset, with the ability to research, resolve issues independently, and deal with ambiguity
* Proficiency with ticketing systems (e.g., Salesforce) and experience working with HRIS platforms is highly desirable; Familiarity with Google Suite (Docs/Sheets), JIRA/Confluence/Slack is a plus
* Professional working proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
* Flexibility to work with US customers in EST (Eastern Standard Time USA) time zone
* Grit, patience, and empathy, as you would be working with different teams, customers, and partners


**Additional Information**
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: PROJECT MANAGER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
 



 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 


 ͏
 
 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 Deliver
 



  
   

 1\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Client satisfaction
   

  
   

 PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
   

  
   

 2\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ operational efficiency
   

  
   

 Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
   

  
   

 3\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Financials
   

  
   

 Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives
   

  
   

 5\.
   

  
   

 Capability Building
   

  
   

 % attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix
   

  
   

 6\.
   

  
   

 Team Management
   

  
   

 Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score
   

  
 


 ͏
 




 Mandatory Skills: Project Delivery .
 



  
 



 Experience: 8\-10 Years
   

 .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

description:
We're Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5,000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.
   

  

 Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.
   

  

 As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities.
   

  

**Why you will love this opportunity as Network Engineer at Civica**
 We are seeking a proficient Network Engineer to join our Civica Infrastructure Team. This role requires a strong foundation in Infrastructure Engineering, as well as comprehensive experience with wide\-area networking technologies and enterprise\-level settings.
   

  

 In this role, your main responsibility will be to oversee, maintain, and continuously enhance the health, resilience, and performance of Civica's network infrastructure. You will work with a diverse array of advanced technologies, including local data centres, hybrid cloud connectivity, multi‑vendor networking, CDN services, and SD‑WAN.
   

  

 You will work closely with platform engineers, hardware engineers, and other network engineers, serving as an escalation point for tactical network issues raised by Support and Operations teams.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
**Network \& Infrastructure Operations**
* Manage and maintain Civica's network infrastructure to ensure availability, performance and security
* Design, build and support networking solutions across on‑premise data centres and hybrid cloud environments
* Support technologies including WAN, LAN, SD‑WAN, CDN services and hybrid cloud connectivity
* Act as a senior technical escalation point for network‑related incidents in a 24x7 operational environment


**Service Delivery \& Customer Engagement**
* Engage with internal Civica business units to deliver projects in line with agreed service levels
* Support environment changes and resolve service outages, including after‑hours activities when required
* Notify and coordinate with multiple resolver teams during service‑affecting incidents


**Documentation \& Accuracy**
* Produce and maintain accurate technical documentation in line with Civica policies and data protection laws
* Create and update:
+ High‑ and low‑level designs
+ Methods of Procedure (MoPs)
+ Network diagrams and maintenance records


**Compliance \& Governance**
* Adhere to Civica's Technology Centre Service Management processes including:
+ Change management
+ Risk management
+ Vendor management
+ Incident, request, and problem management

* Successfully process and implement change requests in line with change management policy


**Continuous Improvement**
* Continuously tune and improve monitoring and alerting systems
* Contribute to knowledge management through feedback, article creation and process improvement
* Proactively suggest improvements to policies, procedures and operational practices
* Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives


**Work Management \& Performance**
* Take personal responsibility for time management and workload
* Meet productivity, utilisation, quality and compliance targets
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and operational excellence
* Achieve annual objectives through the Civica performance management framework


**Team \& Culture**
* Work in a way that reflects Civica's culture and values
* Share knowledge via Confluence and SharePoint


**Requirements**
**What you will bring:**
**Mandatory Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of core networking concepts and architectures
* In‑depth knowledge of network hardware technologies
* Experience in remote and onsite administration
* Strong understanding of network operations environments, systems and services
* Routing protocol expertise: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
* Hands‑on experience designing and supporting:
+ Cisco Nexus and Catalyst switches
+ Cisco ASA and FirePower firewalls

* Knowledge of networking tools and monitoring platforms
* Public cloud networking experience (Azure and/or AWS)
* Ability to understand and execute structured change management processes


**Highly Desirable Technical Competencies**
* LAN, WAN and enterprise networking using Cisco platforms
* Advanced troubleshooting across routing, switching and connectivity issues


**Desirable Qualifications \& Experience**
* Knowledge of cloud networking, load balancers and server technologies
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or Networking
* Networking certifications (preferred)
* In‑depth knowledge of IT Service Management and IT Operations Management tools
* Experience supporting change adoption in a fast‑paced environment


**We Want You to Bring Your Whole Self to Work**
 There is no such thing as the perfect candidate, so if you think you have what it takes but don't necessarily meet every single point on the list above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.
   

  

**Benefits**
**Why you'll love working with us**
 We know that when our people are happy, they will work better and have greater work satisfaction. Here's what you can expect:
   

  

**We're all different** 
 \- and we love this about us.
   

  

**We provide an inclusive,** 
 safe, and welcoming environment to all Civicans, new and old Focus on learning\- there are heaps of opportunities to enable you to grow and be your best.
   

  

**Giving culture** 
 \- we encourage you to "give back" with benefits such as our Days of Difference leave where you can volunteer for a charity of your choice.
   

  

**Flexible Work** 
 \- we have comprehensive flexibility options including part\-time work, adjusted hours, staggered shifts, and hybrid or remote working, supporting work\-life balance based on individual needs.
   

  

**Apply for this job** 
 \- Become part of something special Do you see yourself in this role? If so, then we would love to hear from you.

title: Staff Data Analyst
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join us in a high\-impact role to drive growth at EarnIn. This function plays a critical role in how we use analytics to inform our business \& product priorities, drive data\-backed experiments, deliver value across the consumer lifecycle, and measure performance to optimize future decisions. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to establish end\-to\-end measurement \& reporting, implement rigorous testing methodologies, and drive strategic analyses.



This position will ideally be hybrid, based in our Bengaluru office (HSR Layout), as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers our employees excellent benefits, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Drive strategic analyses that identify key opportunities to improve the core product experience for EarnIn's customers
* Partner with the Product and Engineering teams to design and run experiments
* Upgrade EarnIn's experimentation stack by implementing tools such as Sequential Testing, Bayesian testing, and CUPED
* Partner with the Machine Learning Engineering team to design and build models that form the core of EarnIn's core product
* Monitor \& proactively surface/troubleshoot any problems across the key business metrics \& drive resolution of these issues


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* 7\+ years of experience in product analytics/data science in a B2C role
* Product sense and intuition to drive impact on the business and customer experience
* Experience designing, running, and interpreting experiments.
* Expert skillset in SQL and experience with Python or R
* Practical knowledge of state\-of\-the\-art experimentation tools such as Sequential Testing, Champion/Challenger, CUPED, etc.
* Practical knowledge of machine learning techniques
* Ability to extract insights from large data sets \& seamlessly translate into actionable recommendations across the consumer journey
* Ability to establish and maintain excellent processes while allowing for creative thinking and flexibility in ambiguous situations
* Curiosity and passion for deeply understanding analytical problems and translating this to stakeholders
* Experience in Fintech is a bonus


\#LI\-Hybrid



At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.

**Position Overview**


Are you a tech\-savvy HR Operations leader with a passion for AI, automation, and continuous improvement? The Zelis People \& Culture (P\&C) team is seeking a Senior Manager, P\&C Operations in India to lead the delivery and continuous improvement of P\&C operational services globally. The role is a member of the India P\&C leadership team and has a matrix relationship to Vice President, P\&C Enablement in the US. People Leadership \& Operational Management

* Lead, coach, and develop India P\&C Operations team, including setting objectives, tracking performance, and supporting day\-to\-day execution.
* Support shared services transformation, including identification, hiring, onboarding, and development of team members as operational needs evolve.

Process Excellence, Automation \& AI Enablement

Operational Performance, KPIs \& Service Levels

* Ensure operational metrics are reviewed regularly, performance gaps are addressed proactively, and results are communicated clearly to stakeholders.
* Leverage KPI and service\-level insights to inform process redesign, automation initiatives, and AI\-enabled improvements.


Global Operations Partnership

Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Governance

* Partner with P\&C Technology, Operations, and COEs to support testing, implementation, stabilization, and adoption of new tools, features, and solutions.
* Support work and scope transitions to and from Operations, partnering with COEs and Global Operations to enable centralization and scale.


What You'll Bring:

* Strong understanding of P\&C / HR processes across the employee lifecycle and demonstrated experience with process documentation, process mapping, workflow design, and continuous improvement.
* Proven people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and team development.
* Demonstrated ability to define, analyze, and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and operational performance metrics. Experience using data to drive operational decisions, continuous improvement, and service delivery outcomes.

Our underlying benefits philosophy is this: be fair to our people and provide opportunities for those who take advantage of our programs and resources to lower their health costs and increase their personal and financial security.
  
  

Based in Gurugram or Bangalore \- Reporting into the Head of Talent Acquisition, REMS India, we are currently seeking to hire a Talent Acquisition Team Lead for Project \& Development Services \- India. Project \& Development services is a specialty group that manages design and construction, as well as improvements to our clients’ workspace. The successful applicant will lead and manage this specialized hiring for business across India working closely with senior business stakeholders, HR Business Partners, and the India Talent Acquisition team. You’ll know how employ traditional and creative innovative direct sourcing strategies to enhance our recruiting efforts and processes.

This is a very diverse yet hands on role that comes with great responsibility. You’ll support the recruitment and development of a team of Talent Acquisition Specialists acting as a role model, inspiration, coach giving constructive feedback on a formal and informal basis.
  
  

Collaboration
  
You’ll work closely with the wider Talent Acquisition community \& our JBS teams to ensure successful delivery of talent through multi\-channel sourcing models. In addition, you will communicate regularly with business line leaders to clearly understand requirements and expectations of the diverse positions. This role sits within a highly dynamic part of a highly dynamic business. It’s a fast\-paced environment and you’ll need to be fast paced as well. You’ll need a positive mind set, a ‘can do’ attitude and be comfortable working in environment where there can be ambiguity. We have a continuous improvement mentality across our business, and we’ll be looking for you to want to challenge the status quo and do things differently. You’ll need an entrepreneurial mind\-set and an internal drive to hit goals and succeed in organization that is always looking for the best.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:** –
  
  

Experience
  
This role requires a professional who is accustomed to depth in leading a recruiting function. Preferably, you will need at least 15\+ years’ experience within talent supply chain, recruitment or executive search in Real Estate development/ Construction industry. You understand the different stages of the Talent Acquisition process and be comfortable working on mandates across all levels. Team leadership is second nature and ideally you will be familiar in managing teams across multiple locations. Prior experience of the Real Estate industry, Construction or Engineering is a must.
  
  

Change Evangelist
  
Are you adept at navigating across large, complex organizations? Have you led transformational initiatives overcoming resistance to change to successfully execute strategy? This job is as much about being part of strategic activities and their deployment as it is about managing the talent acquisition needs of our very ever growing India Project \& Development Service Business. You should naturally embrace the challenge of operating in an environment of unprecedented, rapid change where innovation and quick responses yield success.
  
  

Proactive

You should be able to effectively juggle priorities to meet timeframes and deadlines set by the business. In this role we want someone who is naturally decisive and prepared to take risks
  
  

A team player
  
You’re a person that collaborates with others regardless of role, business unit or location. At JLL, we work together to win as One JLL and to help achieve our clients’ goals, as well as those of our team.
  
  

A great communicator
  
Can you get your ideas across clearly both verbally and in writing? You’ll be working with many diverse interest groups so the way you share information and your ability to persuasively convey information is highly important. Strong interpersonal skills are key to this role to establish credibility and respect with internal stakeholders and potential external talent.
  
  

What You Can Expect from Us
  
You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like\-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

title: HR Service Delivery Coordinator
description:
**Summary**


The HR Service Delivery Coordinator plays a critical role in delivering high\-quality HR operations support across employee lifecycle processes, with a strong focus on complex transactions, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.


This role goes beyond transactional support and requires deep expertise in HR operations, the ability to handle escalations, drive process enhancements, and partner with stakeholders across regions. The position also involves mentoring junior team members and contributing to strategic HR initiatives.

**Job Description**


The HR Service Delivery Coordinator acts as an advanced point of contact for employees, managers, HR Business Partners, and external stakeholders across US and Canada regions. The role provides end\-to\-end support across HR operations including Workday transactions, benefits, and employee lifecycle management, while also leading improvements in service delivery and operational excellence.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Employee Lifecycle \& Advanced Transactions**

* Manage and execute complex employee lifecycle transactions in Workday (hires, transfers, promotions, terminations, corrections, and data changes).
* Review and validate documentation for accuracy, compliance, and completeness.
* Handle exception cases and non\-standard transactions with minimal supervision.

**Escalation \& Query Management**

* Act as an escalation point for complex or sensitive employee and manager queries.
* Resolve intricate issues related to HR policies, payroll, benefits, and HR systems.
* Partner with COEs (Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, Mobility) for timely resolution.

**Payroll \& Benefits Support**

* Provide advanced support for payroll and benefits\-related queries, including issue investigation and resolution.
* Liaise with vendors and internal teams for escalated cases.

**Process Improvement \& Projects**

* Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and employee experience.
* Lead or contribute to HR service delivery projects, including system enhancements and transitions.
* Develop and implement standardized procedures and best practices.

**Data Management, Reporting \& Analytics**

* Conduct HR data audits to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Generate and analyze HR reports and dashboards for management insights.
* Leverage data to recommend improvements and support decision\-making.

**Onboarding \& Background Verification Oversight**

* Oversee onboarding processes and ensure seamless execution for complex or high\-touch cases.
* Manage escalations in background verification processes and ensure compliance.

**Team Support \& Mentoring**

* Provide guidance, training, and mentoring to junior team members (B3 and below).
* Act as a knowledge resource and support capability building within the team.
* May coordinate work allocation and support team deliverables.

**Coverage Area**

* Support employees and stakeholders across US and Canada regions.
* Provide cross\-functional and cross\-regional support as required.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
* **Experience:** 4–7 years of experience in HR Operations / Shared Services, with strong exposure to US HR processes.
* **HR Expertise:** In\-depth knowledge of employee lifecycle, benefits, and HR compliance.
* **Technical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in Workday or similar HRIS; strong Excel and reporting skills.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage senior stakeholders.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to handle complex scenarios.
* **Attention to Detail:** High level of accuracy in managing sensitive HR data and transactions.
* **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to mentor team members and lead initiatives.
* **Personal Attributes:** Customer\-focused, proactive, ownership mindset, and ability to work under pressure.

**Work Schedule**

* **Shift:** US Shifts (Night Shift)
* **Location:** Pune

**Our Interview Practices**
---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

You operate, from day one, as a* ***Product Builder****. In 12–18 months, you grow into a* ***Product Engineer*** *or a* ***Product Manager*** *— three of the highest\-leverage seats in the company.*

*You'll write PRDs. Ship Feature Specs. Configure mGrant Donor setups using AI. Run QA. Learn the Frappe stack on the job. Use Claude Max with a real token budget. And get mentored directly by* ***Senior Product Managers, Senior Project Managers, Subject Matter Experts, and Senior Management*** *— plus the AI communities Dhwani is wired into.*

*If the next 3 years of your life look like that — apply.*

**About Dhwani**

Dhwani Rural Information Systems is a Delhi\-NCR, India headquartered 10\+ year\-old social/development sector advisory and consulting firm. We build tech for NGOs, government, CSRs, and international funding organizations across India and abroad. 100\+ ICT4D professionals. mGrant is our flagship grants management platform — used by some of India's largest social\-sector donors.

You'll join the **mGrant Donor** team — the vertical handling end\-to\-end grant lifecycles for corporate donors, with sub\-tracks across **Finance, Impact, and LFA (Logical Framework Approach)**.

**What You'll Actually Do**

**Write — PRDs and Feature Specs**

* Write complete PRDs for client project deployments — goals, personas, workflows, edge cases.
* Write Feature Specs that go directly to engineering — structured, unambiguous, build\-ready.
* Translate Senior Product Manager / SME / client direction into structured documentation.
* Maintain a living requirements library — versioned, clean, reusable.

**Configure \& Build — using AI**

* Configure mGrant Donor setups for new clients: Property Setters, Custom Fields, Workflows, Print Formats, Notifications.
* Build small features on existing setups using AI assistance — Server Scripts, Client Scripts, Report Builder, Dashboard Charts.
* Use AI as your build partner — never blindly; always reviewed, tested, owned.
* Hand off to engineers cleanly when the work crosses into production code.

**Test \& Validate**

* Write detailed use\-case scenarios grounded in real mGrant Donor deployments.
* Design and execute structured test cases across modules — grant lifecycle, approvals, disbursement, reporting.
* Log bugs in Linear with reproduction steps, expected vs actual behavior, environment.
* Run regression testing before every release. Validate role\-based access and workflow logic against the PRD.

**Coordinate \& Document**

* Track sprint progress, surface blockers, maintain delivery timelines.
* Run MoMs, weekly reports, client\-facing delivery summaries — structured enough to forward without editing.
* Support data migration cycles — validation, cleansing, structuring incoming client data.
* Develop working familiarity with Frappe, MariaDB, SQL, and APIs within the first 6 months.

**How You'll Work**

* **Interview before executing.** Ask probing questions until you're \~95% sure of intent. Wrong assumption \= rework.
* **Surgical scope.** Every output traces back to the explicit ask. No scope creep, no "while I'm here" extras.
* **Quality \> shortcuts.** Never assume when you can verify. Never forward work you haven't reviewed.
* **Clean handoffs.** End every working day with a HEARTBEAT entry — Done / Pending / Blocked / Next / Decisions.
* **Opinionated voice.** If you see a flaw in the plan, say so before you execute. Your Senior Product Manager wants a thinking partner, not a yes\-machine.

**Must\-Haves**

* Bachelor's in Business, CS, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or related.
* Strong structured thinking and written communication.
* High Excel proficiency.
* Comfort writing PRDs and Feature Specs from ambiguous inputs.
* Daily HEARTBEAT discipline.
* Real comfort using AI tools for actual work — drafting, structuring, critiquing — not as a toy.
* Curiosity about technical systems (Frappe / MariaDB / SQL / APIs). You don't need to know them — you need to want to learn them.
* Ownership: you finish what you start, or you flag what's blocking you.

**AI\-Native — How You'll Operate**

AI tools are part of your daily working stack — not a side curiosity. You should already know, or be willing to learn fast:

* Prompt structuring, context framing, iterative refinement.
* System instructions, task decomposition, and tool selection — knowing when Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini / Perplexity is the right call.
* Critical evaluation of AI outputs — review, challenge, correct before forwarding.
* Token economics and cost discipline — operate cleanly inside limits.

*It's fine if you don't have all of this on day one — but the curiosity has to be yours. We'll build you toward this.*

**What Dhwani Adds On Top of Standard Compensation**

(Salary, medical insurance, leaves, and other standard benefits are handled by HR per Dhwani's policies. The list below is the additional leverage you get by being on this team.)

**AI Stack**

* Claude Max access from day one

* Access to Senior Project Managers and Subject Matter Experts across the org

**Career Path**

* Year 1: Product Analyst — operating as a Product Builder

title: FIRE ASSAY MASTER
description:
**Role Objective**

We are seeking a high\-caliber **Process Engineer** with a background in **Mechanical or Chemical Engineering** to oversee our Fire Assay and Precious Metal Refining department. Unlike a standard technician role, you will be responsible for the technical integrity, process optimization, and industrial scaling of our assaying operations. You will bridge the gap between traditional craftsmanship and modern engineering to ensure our jewellery alloys meet world\-class standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Process Engineering \& Optimization**

* Analyze existing fire assay workflows to improve throughput and reduce "gold loss" during the fusion and cupellation stages.
* Implement Statistical Process Control (SPC) to monitor the accuracy and precision of assay results.
* Troubleshoot chemical inconsistencies in the parting process (acid\-to\-metal ratios).

**2\. Equipment \& Systems Management**

* **Mechanical Focus:** Oversee the maintenance and calibration of automated dosing systems, muffle furnaces, and high\-precision micro\-balances.
* **Chemical Focus:** Manage the chemical laboratory, ensuring proper handling, neutralization, and disposal of hazardous effluents and nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions.

**3\. Quality Assurance \& Compliance**

* Act as the technical lead for internal audits and compliance with international hallmarking standards.
* Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the preparation of "proof" samples and gold cornets.

**4\. Safety \& Environmental Engineering**

* Design and maintain advanced ventilation and scrubbers systems to ensure a lead\-free work environment.
* Lead safety training regarding thermal hazards and chemical hygiene.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Education:** **B.Tech / B.E. in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.**
* **Experience:** 1\+ years in an industrial lab, metallurgy plant, or jewellery manufacturing facility (Fire Assay experience is a significant advantage) (Fresher can also apply).
* **Technical Proficiency:**
* Knowledge of thermodynamics and heat transfer (for furnace optimization).
* Understanding of mass balance and stoichiometry (for chemical assaying).
* Proficiency in CAD (for floor layout/equipment design) or Minitab/Excel (for data analysis).

Job Type: Permanent

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Junior Mechanical Engineer**

**Experience:** Minimum 2 years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month  
**Location:** Bhiwandi, Maharashtra

You’ll be working directly on production and machines. The role blends hands\-on machine handling with technical design work.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* Run and manage **auto hinges packing machine** with focus on output and efficiency
* Identify production issues and fix them—not just report them
* Handle **machine maintenance** (minor to moderate issues) without constant supervision
* Work on **2D/3D designs (Mastercam / Delcam or similar)** and execute them on CNC/VMC
* Ensure production quality, accuracy, and minimal downtime

**Strict Requirements (No Exceptions)**

* Minimum **2 years hands\-on experience** in mechanical/production environment
* Must have **ANY 2 of these 3 skillsets**:
* Production handling
* Machine maintenance
* CNC/VMC \+ 2D/3D design
* Comfortable working on the shop floor (this is not a desk job)
* Able to troubleshoot independently (we’re not looking for someone who needs constant guidance)

**Who Should NOT Apply**

* Freshers
* Pure design engineers with no machine exposure
* Candidates who avoid hands\-on work
* People who need step\-by\-step instructions for everything

**What You Get**

* Direct exposure to real production and machines
* Opportunity to handle responsibility early
* Fast learning curve

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
